sourceObservations: The native snapshot is a backless golden honey-wood stool: square seat with clipped corners, three broad seat boards separated by two lines, brown splayed supports, and a horizontal lower stretcher.

The seat is bright flat yellow with narrow orange perimeter facets and little visible surface variation; the brown legs are considerably darker, with hard polygon transitions and near-black lower/inset regions.

The one-cell seat identity, board layout, splay and leg/stretcher separation are already readable. The main opportunity is softer material modeling and more readable lower support volume, without enlarging the seat or raising its socket.
targetObservations: The selected reskin retains the warm yellow/orange seat and brown base, but broad soft highlights and gently shaded edge bands give a rounded, substantial cartoon wood impression.
The three boards remain distinct with softly inset warm brown-orange seams. The legs and stretcher gain orange-brown midtones, smoother volume and more readable edge transitions.
The reskin rounds and widens the seat perimeter and changes padding/registration. Those silhouette shifts are not authority over source proportions, sockets, camera or bounds.
Scattered bright edge pixels, warm outline glow and isolated colored speckles around the target are image-generation artifacts; they are not desired model or alpha features.

rankedDesiredOutcomes.outcome: Replace the uniformly bright seat face and abrupt thin facets with broad restrained honey-gold shading and softened bevel transitions, preserving the original thin square three-board seat.
Make brown legs, underside and stretcher read as continuous warm wooden volumes with distinguishable support edges; avoid near-black dead spots and muddy joins.
Keep soft inset board seams and subtle wood character readable at logical sprite size, without sharp glowing yellow outlines, noisy grain or enlarged silhouette.
